🕳️ W7s Blackhole Ultimate V60
Turn anything into a black hole. 31 formations, anime jutsu, and a full combat sandbox — all in one mobile-friendly GUI.
W7s Blackhole Ultimate is the ultimate all-in-one Black Hole / gravity control script for Roblox. It hijacks the parts all around you, drags them into orbit, and compiles them into 31 different master formations — from a simple ring to a fully modeled JoJo Stand, three Susanoo giants, and a modern main battle tank.
Then you put them to use: jutsu, blades, spirit attacks, auto-lock, auto-attack, spectating, and a full protection suite so you can survive long enough to enjoy it.
Built with a mobile-first design (optimized for Delta and touch devices), featuring a two-row tab bar, big finger-friendly buttons, a draggable on-screen HUD, and a full bilingual interface switch (Indonesian / English).
🌌 31 MASTER FORMATIONS
Core & Geometric:
Classic Ring • Cyclone Tornado • Spherical Dome • Singularity Blackhole • Parametric Heart • 4 Satellite Orbs • Saturn Ring • Shield Wall • Infinity Loop • Pentagram Star • Gudodama (Naruto) • Galaxy Spiral
Anime & Cyber:
Angel Crown Halo • Double DNA Helix • Susanoo Wings • Raijin Ring • Atomic Gyroscope • Sacred Lotus • Prismatic Pyramid • Cyber Tesseract
Characters & Vehicles:
Susanoo Madara (blue) • Rinnegan Moon • Odama Rasengan • Gate of Babylon • Malevolent Shrine • Senbonzakura • Chidori Aura • JoJo Stand (Star Platinum) • Susanoo Sasuke (purple) • Susanoo Itachi (red) • MBT Modern (Tank)
> 6 of them are real hand-modeled builds, not just math: Susanoo Wings, Madara, Star Platinum, Sasuke, Itachi, and the Tank.
> 
🔧 KEY FEATURES
Inside the Shape Engine
 * 3 Stand Poses: Menacing Guardian, ORA-ORA, Pointing.
 * Real Body Modeling: Limbs, pauldrons, boots, hair, layered wing feathers, tank treads, and rotating turret.
 * Zone coloring, glowing neon eyes/weapons, idle breathing/hair/wing animation, and speed control.
 * Part Spin System: Spin or freeze, reverse direction, snap to any 45° on X/Y/Z.
 * Rigid / Statue / Flush-to-surface modes so the build looks clean instead of blobby.
 * Size scaling, height offset, Stand distance, orbit offsets, and 3D rotation (pitch/yaw/roll).
🎯 Combat Sandbox
 * Giant Hand and Blade Slasher (adjustable hand size / blade length).
 * Hollow Purple (Gojo), Divine Palm Smash, jutsu replication animation.
 * Super Lock (infinite target loop) with auto-random scan and nearest-player picker.
 * Wall-piercing attacks — hit targets hiding inside buildings.
 * Preset attack speed & reach, Instant Attack, hit-and-run mode, launch-attack button.
 * Staging animation, ammo count, random multi-target count.
🧲 Grab, Radius & Ownership
 * Far Grab: Pull parts from up to 2000 studs, adjustable pull speed and push-off distance.
 * Tractor beam depth (through floors), horizontal 3D radius, part quota, max/min/forced part size.
 * Ghost Scan: Grab parts that are intangible.
 * Simulation Radius domination (plus min/ceiling) for far-away ownership.
 * Harvester: Send up to 10 drone parts to farm for you.
 * Auto-whitelist friends, auto-reclaim on a new round, Anti-Steal Ownership Guard.
 * Pull NPCs and dropped tools too, and force NPC ownership to you.
 * Built-in Measuring Tools: Target-distance test, ownership-chain diagnosis, one-part far claim test, copyable report.
